behavior: Once response headers are received, every HTTP AI provider uses the remaining absolute request budget for response-body consumption. Repeated bytes cannot extend it.
On expiry, only the request-owned socket is shut down and the response closed; callers receive sanitized AI_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT. Explicit user cancellation retains precedence.
Successful responses within budget remain valid; timeout and success leave no deadline watchdog running.
Durable AI worker makes one request, records BLOCKED / AI_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT, saves no partial evaluation and exposes the same outcome through fresh database/API readback.
